description: Protect Jellyfin 12 native subtitle caches, with optional bounded remote ASS preparation for native HLS burn-in.
name: SubtitleGuard
overview: Guard native subtitle caches and optionally prepare remote ASS burn-in windows.

versions.changelog: SubtitleGuard 0.4.14: restyles ASS subtitles extracted from covered remote .strm sources into one standard bottom-centre style scaled to the script canvas, removing override tags, positions, drawings and effects while keeping every event time and line. The same standard style is used for bounded ASS burn-in windows. Scripts that are not plain V4+ files are left unchanged. Existing caches change only when re-extracted. Recovery of covered extraction, cancellation, incomplete-output rejection and source-bound cache receipts are unchanged. Requires Jellyfin 12 and a full restart.

SubtitleGuard 0.4.13: restyles ASS subtitles extracted from covered remote .strm sources into one standard bottom-centre style scaled to the script canvas, removing override tags, positions, drawings and effects while keeping every event time and line. The same standard style is used for bounded ASS burn-in windows. Scripts that are not plain V4+ files are left unchanged. Existing caches change only when re-extracted. Recovery of covered extraction, cancellation, incomplete-output rejection and source-bound cache receipts are unchanged. Requires Jellyfin 12 and a full restart.

SubtitleGuard 0.4.12: fixes recovery of covered remote .strm subtitle extraction when FFmpeg progress output precedes a matched HTTP premature-EOF and reconnect pair. Recovery still requires successful exit, complete same-read video coverage and no remaining failure. Cancellation, incomplete-output rejection, source-bound cache receipts and one outer retry remain. Optional windowed ASS HLS burn-in is unchanged. Requires Jellyfin 12 and a full restart.

SubtitleGuard 0.4.11: enables bounded native HTTP reconnect for covered remote .strm subtitle extraction. Matched recovered EOF diagnostics are accepted only with successful exit, complete same-read video coverage and no remaining failure. Cancellation, incomplete-output rejection, source-bound cache receipts and one outer retry remain. Optional windowed ASS HLS burn-in is unchanged. Requires Jellyfin 12 and a full restart.

SubtitleGuard 0.4.10: validates same-read video coverage before publishing remote embedded subtitle extraction for local .strm items. Legacy .strm caches are revalidated on demand and fully covered results are source-bound in cache metadata. One bounded retry remains. Optional windowed ASS HLS burn-in and native cache guards remain. Requires Jellyfin 12 and a full restart.

SubtitleGuard 0.4.7: retries one transient native subtitle transport failure before rejecting incomplete output. Optional bounded remote ASS preparation and existing cache guards remain. Set SUBTITLEGUARD_WINDOWED_ASS=1 to enable windowed burn-in for all users. Requires Jellyfin 12 and a full restart.

SubtitleGuard 0.4.6: retries one transient native subtitle transport failure before rejecting incomplete output. Optional bounded remote ASS preparation and existing cache guards remain. Set SUBTITLEGUARD_WINDOWED_ASS=1 to enable windowed burn-in for all users. Requires Jellyfin 12 and a full restart.

SubtitleGuard 0.4.3: retries one transient native subtitle transport failure before rejecting incomplete output. Optional bounded remote ASS preparation and existing cache guards remain. Set SUBTITLEGUARD_WINDOWED_ASS=1 to enable windowed burn-in for all users. Requires Jellyfin 12 and a full restart.

SubtitleGuard 0.4.2: opt-in bounded remote ASS preparation for native HLS burn-in on Linux. Existing incomplete-cache guards retained. Set SUBTITLEGUARD_WINDOWED_ASS=1 to enable for all users; unsupported or failed preparation falls back to guarded native extraction. Requires Jellyfin 12 and a full restart.

SubtitleGuard 0.4.1: opt-in bounded remote ASS preparation for native HLS burn-in on Linux. Existing incomplete-cache guards retained. Set SUBTITLEGUARD_WINDOWED_ASS=1 to enable for all users; unsupported or failed preparation falls back to guarded native extraction. Requires Jellyfin 12 and a full restart.

SubtitleGuard 0.3.1: fixes Harmony startup in Jellyfin's collectible plugin loader. Native extraction/cache guards retained; no downloader, queue or settings. Requires Jellyfin 12 and a restart to activate.
SubtitleGuard 0.3.0: lean native extraction/cache guard; no custom downloader, queue or settings. Requires Jellyfin 12 and a restart to activate.
SubtitleGuard 0.1.1: guarded subtitle extraction for Jellyfin 12. Requires an explicit source policy and coordinated startup-gate updates where applicable.
